overclaims: Controlled experiments also document serious failures when familiar assumptions change (e2).
The decisive study is a preprint with a constrained task and does not analyze all internal components.
checks.note: Excerpt, proposition, condition, outcome (causal_assessment, contradicted, not_applicable) and the e1/e2 citations are correct. e1 (2024-05-06) predates the post. Two problems: (1) The limitation says e1 'does not analyze all internal components', but neither the evidence nor the stated gaps support this; the gaps mention only a constrained task and one model. (2) 'serious failures' goes beyond e2's 'substantial degradation', especially since e2 also reports above-random counterfactual performance. Suggested wording: 'substantial performance degradation'.
